verdict.rationale: Context.dev documents a dedicated URL discovery guide. It reads a site's public sitemaps and returns a filtered URL list without rendering each page, and it can map all of a website's URLs from Context.dev's index with titles, descriptions, keywords and languages. This directly meets the 'without fully crawling' requirement. Missing for 10: evidence of response speed backing the 'instantly' claim, and independent or hands-on corroboration of how complete the URL discovery is.

support.subject: As a developer, I can instantly discover all URLs on a website without fully crawling it

citations.quote: Read a website's public sitemaps and return a filtered URL list without rendering each page.
Map all URLs a website has using Context.dev's index, with available page titles, descriptions, keywords, and languages.
